title: Electrical Engineer
description: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, or a Diploma in Engineering, with relevant engineering, design or 3D modelling experience on Basic / FEED and detail engineering of Indian and international projects. Experience in FPSO topsides engineering is highly desirable.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in the basis of design, specifications, SLDs, datasheets, load lists, lighting and calculations.
Generator sizing, electrical equipment specifications, AC / DC UPS and battery sizing calculations, electrical bulk items.
Experience in ETAP, DIALux and SPEL.
source: Approved recruitment advertisement, Times of India (Southern editions), 18-11-2026
